source_note: Pairs synthetic F 5100.31 application forms (testdata/build_good_sets.py) with existing real label image groups from testdata/ (cataloged in manifest.json, WBS 2.1) to form complete 'good' (all-fields-match) test sets, one per product type. Form field values were chosen to match what is printed on each product's label images, so every Sec. 2.5 Parameter Comparison Matrix rule resolves to MATCH (or NOT_APPLICABLE where the form field is intentionally blank for that product type) and the expected pipeline outcome is APPROVE. Comparison rule references are DevLog.md Sec. 2.5; allowable-revision references are Sec. 2.6.
